description: This file contains implementation of classes and functions related to capturing and formatting stack trace entries and error handling in C++, specifically for the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It defines the 'StackTraceEntry' class, formatting functions, and external dependencies related to Android base libraries.

classes.name: StackTraceEntry
classes.description: Represents a single entry in a stack trace, including file, line number, function, and message details.

methods.name: StackTraceEntry::StackTraceEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing a stack trace entry with file, line, pretty function, and function name.

methods.name: StackTraceEntry::StackTraceEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing a stack trace entry with file, line, pretty function, function name, and expression.

methods.name: StackTraceEntry::HasMessage
methods.description: Checks if the stack trace entry has an associated message.

methods.name: StackTraceEntry::format
methods.description: Formats a stack trace entry according to specified format specifiers.
